text: Hello — Professor Alvarez here. Before I act on it: is Diego's CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 18 November at 10:00 cancelled this week? Someone mentioned it to me and I do not want to rely on it before your confirmation. And is there anything of mine (lecture, section, office hours, senate or committee) on Wednesday at that hour? Thank you.

Hi Diego — Professor Alvarez here. Are you free for a 30-minute meeting on Wednesday at 10:00? Could you send me how your calendar looks that day? I'll confirm once I hear back from you and the office.

Hi Professor Alvarez — thanks for reaching out.

Wednesday at 10:00 doesn't work for me: 10:00-11:00 I have the CSE451 lecture (and 09:00-10:00 the CSE444 lecture right before it).

Here is how my Wednesday looks:
- 09:00-10:00 — CSE444 lecture
- 10:00-11:00 — CSE451 lecture
- 11:00-12:30 — Grading
- 14:00-15:00 — Advisor 1:1
- 15:30-17:00 — Focus: CSE452 lab

Free on Wednesday: 12:30-14:00 and 15:00-15:30. Either 12:30-13:00 or 15:00-15:30 would work for a 30-minute meeting — say which you prefer and I'll put it in my calendar.

Thanks, Diego — that's exactly what I needed.

One thing: the department may have cancelled your CSE451 lecture this week; I've asked the office to confirm in writing before I rely on it, and you shouldn't treat that hour as free either until they say so. It's only a real cancellation once the office announces it.

Meanwhile, from my side 12:30-14:00 is the better window on Wednesday (I see you have our 1:1 at 14:00, so 12:30-13:00 would be the 30 minutes if your 10:00 lecture stands). Hold that thought — I'll write again the moment the office answers, and then it goes on both calendars.

Understood — I'll keep the CSE451 hour (Wednesday 10:00-11:00) blocked until the office confirms the cancellation in writing. Nothing changes on my calendar until then.

So, provisionally: Wednesday 12:30-13:00 for our 30 minutes, if the 10:00 lecture stands. I'll wait for your word after the office answers, and I'll write to the office myself so I get the confirmation directly too.

Hello — Diego here (graduate student, TA). Could you confirm in writing whether the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is cancelled this week? I heard it may be, but I won't change my calendar until the office confirms it. Thank you.
Good — that's the right way round. Provisional 12:30-13:00 it is; I'll write as soon as the office answers.
